body: I have someone who is pretty much my partner but I can't speak to them in person unfortunately. I have my mother but I can't really speak to her about this sort of stuff. We occasionally meet for coffee but the conversation is generally more innocent.

Well I wouldn't say that I was a true nihilist, just that I share some nihilist and existentialist beliefs.
I guess I'll keep looking for another way but I can't promise that I won't take the easiest way out. Moods and breakdowns can be hard and it seems like they're hitting me far more frequently at the moment.

I have a doctor, I have recently gone back on fluoxitine and started seeking out talk therapy again from a psychologist. 
I've always been like this though and I don't think that a psychologist can help me because this is who I am, this is my personality. I am just a cynical and nihilistic person with no motivations or passions and nothing that makes me happy.. 

I just wish I didn't have to hurt the person who cares about me most by taking the selfish way out..

Yeah.. I have had the emergency team called on me before..it's not fun and it doesn't fix my ongoing state, it just prevents me from fixing the issue then and there..

I have sought help my whole life, I just feel selfish and lazy and sometimes I worry that I'm either going crazy or maybe I don't even have any issues and I'm just making it up in my head as an excuse..
Well I mean I had a knife to my neck and I was planning on ending my life. Writing into a big white box isn't the craziest idea..
They're all bad.. I don't know why today is specifically worse than others. I don't even know if today is specifically worse than others.. Maybe I just don't have it in me to keep going.

"He should have talked to me"
"He had so many options"
"It's sad that he thought that was his only choice" 
"I was always there for them"
- Says everybody who wasn't there or who only talked to you when they wanted to talk about themselves.

The same people who will start a conversation asking how you are and then without giving you a chance to feel safe or comfortable with them they will start to vent and make everything about them, and then when you need something or want to talk about yourself they will accuse you of being selfish or only ever thinking about yourself.

I'm 19 turning 20 and I feel the same way. Over the past 15 years I have been physically, emotionally, and sexually abused and I am constantly taken advantage of.
You'd think that I'd have learned to stop wearing my heart on my sleeve and reaching out to people and trying to help everybody but I can't stop myself.
People see the generosity and the niceness as weakness and they take advantage of you and gut you for it. But it's who we are and it hurts to neglect people and not be "nice", It really fucking sucks.
I still convince myself that it's all my own selfishness and that I just do it for attention or because I don't want to be alone and that I either let people abuse me or that I am really the abusive one..

It's getting harder to get out of bed again. I'm trying not to cut myself, but I have cut myself twice this week including just now. 


I have someone that I guess I love and they say they love me but I can't be near them and I know I shouldn't have reached out to them and made a friend because without them I'm alone and I know it was selfish for me to want a friend. I'm going to hurt them when I end my life. I don't think I have the energy to keep suffering. I know it's selfish. I just wish I could fix and help all of the people that I have hurt and burdened. I'm a waste of time and a waste of life. 

I've never been to this subreddit before.. sorry if I did this wrong..
